message.content:
This is a flat-style wallet with an outer surface of man-made textile material, so it falls in heading 4202, subheading 4202.32 (articles of a kind normally carried in the pocket or handbag, with outer surface of plastic sheeting or textile materials). Within that, 4202.32.99 covers other items with textile outer surface, and the statistical suffix is the usual 9, which I am assuming rather than confirming here. I recall the 4202.32.9500 line as "Other: Of man-made fibers" and 4202.32.9000 as "Other," but this is from memory and not checked.

Candidate lines from memory:
- 4202.32.10: articles with outer surface of sheeting of plastic
- 4202.32.20: of cotton
- 4202.32.9000: other. This may have been split into 4202.32.9100 (of vegetable fibers) and 4202.32.9500 (other).

The wallets are man-made textile, so I am choosing 4202.32.9500. This is my best recollection of the current line, not a verified one.
